en.text: I dropped an earring on the floor and had to get down on all fours to find it.

original: その夜は、早く床についた。

en.text: I went to bed early that night.

original: 携帯が床に落ちた。

en.text: My phone fell on the floor.

original: 床は、水浸しだった。

en.text: The floor was soaked with water.
